newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - IPE Brent seen taking breather, $17.54 key.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - IPE Brent seen taking breather, $17.54 key.

text.p: NEARBY MONTH CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI-14 * MA-10 * MA-20
+ IPE Brent futures were expected to pause for breath on Tuesday following recent substantial losses.
+ Key support seen at $17.54 a barrel in line with low of April 10.
+ Gas oil seen oscillating around $160.00 level with support at $159.50 and resistance at $162.00.
IPE Brent futures were expected to brake their downward path on Tuesday, at least temporarily, as the market paused for breath after the substantial losses of the past two sessions, chartists said.
July IPE Brent closed 14 cents lower at $17.56 a barrel on Monday while Junr gas oil ended $4.25 off at $161.00 a tonne.
"We might see a small corrective bounce but I can't see it getting back into the $20 range in a hurry," Darren Gurner at Sucden said.
Gurner pinpointed key support at $17.54 and $17.48 in line with the lows of April 10, 1997 and June 14, 1996 on the front month continuation chart.
Below there, he noted support at the lows of the downward spike seen on May 20, 1996 at $16.75.
Gurner said a bounce off $17.54 would leave a double bottom on the chart which could be mildly supportive for the market in the short-term.
On the upside, Gurner noted resistance around the $18.80 level in line with where the 40-day moving average cuts the daily chart.
Chartists at MeesPierson Derivatives regarded the market as fairly neutral but were on the look-out for short-covering opportunities.
"On the technical front we have negative preparation but watch like a hawk for those buying extremes to cover shorts," they said in their daily report.
They pegged resistance at $17.85, $18.20 and $18.50 and support around $17.50, $17.35 and $17.15.
"If weakness persists we would join a break, selling beneath $17.45, covering at $17.80 if we then later rallied," they said.
Gas oil was expected to oscillate around the $160.00 level it closed at on Monday.
MeesPierson pegged support at $159.50, $158.00, $155.00 and resistance at $162.00, $164.50 and $168.00. -- Melanie Goodfellow, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7714.
